subject: MedStream AI — Request for one-off onboarding credit & blended pricing approval (VP/CFO escalation)
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MedStream AI — Request for one-off onboarding credit & blended pricing approval (VP/CFO escalation)

Team — quick background and ask.

Opportunity: MedStream AI (Series B, health SaaS) is asking for a tailored onboarding package to win a pilot with 3 large hospital systems. They are willing to commit to a 12-month minimum and have indicated a willingness to consolidate all inference traffic with Redwood if initial latency/cost looks good. HubSpot deal: DEAL-119 (link below).

Current ask from customer: 20% off list pricing for first 6 months + a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to $60,000 to offset integration and data-transfer setup. Their procurement deadline is next Wednesday (1/20).

Why we should consider: strategic reference (healthcare), multi-region needs (US + EU later), potential to convert to Dedicated capacity Q3, and good cross-sell motion into embeddings/analysis. Risk is short-term ARR dilution.

Attached: medstream_term_sheet.pdf, pricing_impact_model.xlsx (simple 24-month P&L with margin scenarios).

My recommendation (preferred):
- Approve a blended concession: 15% standard discount for first 3 months, then step to 10% for months 4–6 (effective blended ~13%).
- Replace $60k cash credit with a $40k onboarding credit that is applied as a service credit (non-refundable) tied to usage milestones (50% release upon production launch; remainder at 90 days).
- Require a 12-month minimum commitment and a 30% increase in committed token volume after month 6, or the remaining credits step off.

Net impact (high level): ~6.8% ARR dilution year 1 under conservative uptake; downside protected by milestone-linked credits. Full detail in pricing_impact_model.xlsx.

Because the ask exceeds Commercial Manager authority thresholds and the one-time credit is outside standard playbooks, I need VP/CFO signoff by EOD Tuesday to meet procurement timing.

Proposed approval language to send to procurement once signed: “Redwood approves a blended onboarding concession as outlined in attached term sheet. Concession conditioned on milestone acceptance and a 12-month contracted minimum. All credits are one-time service credits and non-refundable.”

Please review attached and respond with: APPROVE / ADJUST / DECLINE and any suggested alternative structures.

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: medstream_term_sheet.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: pricing_impact_model.xlsx (xlsx)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-119

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedStream AI — Request for one-off onboarding credit & blended pricing approval (VP/CFO escalation)

Michael — thanks for the concise brief. A few quick questions / comments inline: 

> My recommendation (preferred):
> - Approve a blended concession: 15% standard discount for first 3 months, then step to 10% for months 4–6 (effective blended ~13%).

Have you modeled an alternative that replaces the time-based discount with a usage-based ramp (e.g., no discount but a consumption rebate if they hit X tokens/mo for two consecutive months)? That preserves list pricing while rewarding pull-through.

> - Replace $60k cash credit with a $40k onboarding credit applied as a service credit tied to usage milestones

I prefer credits tied to quantifiable milestones (prod launch, 90d usage) — good call. Confirm the tax/recognition treatment with FP&A; service credits still require finance intake.

Follow-ups:
- Karthik — can you run the contracted-margin impact (worst / base / best) for these two options and flag if GAAP recognition changes materially? I want a 48-hour turnaround.
- Marissa — if we push for a milestone release schedule and a 12-month minimum, will Commercial Ops' standard SOW language cover the usage milestone clauses or do we draft a bespoke addendum?

If we can move to the milestone-linked rebate structure (rather than a straight percent off), I think we preserve revenue and still give MedStream what they want. If not, we should keep the credit size smaller (<= $40k) and insist on firm volume commitments.

–Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Garza <elena@medstream.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Procurements <procure@medstream.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedStream AI — Request for one-off onboarding credit & blended pricing approval (VP/CFO escalation)

Hi Michael — appreciate the clear ask and the model. We are under a hard procurement timeline from the hospitals and need legal/finance paperwork in place by 1/21 to hit their integration window. 

We can be flexible on structure. Two options that would work for us: 
1) The blended % discount for the first 6 months as you proposed.
2) Milestone-tied onboarding credit (preferred) — we can agree milestones (prod launch + 90-day usage) and provide a short acceptance signoff from our engineering lead.

On the onboarding credit: we would prefer the credit to be applied as an offset on monthly billing rather than a separate invoice credit.

If you can confirm which structure Redwood will approve today, Procurement will start redlining the T&Cs and push to sign by Thursday.

Thanks,
Elena Garza
Head of Procurement, MedStream AI

Attachment: medstream_intake_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Garza <elena@medstream.ai>, Procurements <procure@medstream.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedStream AI — Request for one-off onboarding credit & blended pricing approval (VP/CFO escalation)

Kimberly / Marissa / Karthik — following Elena's note, I pulled together two concise options for VP/CFO signoff. I will escalate as soon as I have the team position so Procurement can proceed. Quick summary to circulate to leadership: 

OPTION A — Milestone-linked onboarding credit (preferred)
- Structure: $40,000 total onboarding credit applied as a monthly billing offset. Release schedule: $20k when production is accepted; $20k at 90 days if usage >= 60% of committed volume.
- Pricing: no upfront % discount; list pricing applies. If usage for months 4–6 averages 80%+ of committed volume we will convert to a 10% volume rebate for months 7–12 (retroactive).
- Commercial guardrails: 12-month minimum contract; early termination voids remaining credits.
- Impact: ~3.2% ARR dilution year 1 in base uptake case; lowest ARR downside vs straight discount.

OPTION B — Blended time-based discount (fallback)
- Structure: 15% off list for months 1–3; 10% off for months 4–6.
- Onboarding credit: none (or up to $10k to cover minor integration fees).
- Impact: ~6.8% ARR dilution year 1 in base case.

Recommendation: Approve OPTION A. I am requesting an explicit VP/CFO signoff template below that leadership can paste into a reply.

Proposed signoff copy: “Approved: Redwood will accept Option A (milestone-linked $40k onboarding credit + 12-month minimum, milestone and usage clauses as described). Finance to confirm recognition treatment with FP&A; Commercial Ops to add milestone addendum to SOW.”

If I don’t hear an objection, I’ll escalate to VP/CFO with recommendation language and the attached model. We need signoff by EOD Tues to meet Procurement timeline.

Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
